board: New York State Education Department — State Board for Public Accountancy

cycle.note: CPE is tracked January 1 – December 31 each year. No credits carry forward to the next year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours in any mix of recognized subject areas, or 24 hours in one area (accounting, attest, auditing, taxation, advisory services or specialized knowledge). Ethics taken this year counts toward either (NYSED Q&A). No carryforward.

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: If New York is your principal place of business, only an ethics course approved by NYSED is acceptable.

requirements.label: Attest competency
requirements.note: If you supervise attest or compilation work or sign reports: 40 hours in accounting, auditing or attest in the three calendar years before the year you do the work, or in that year on its own (NYSED Q&A 5). The same hours also count toward your 24 or 40 for the year.

newLicensee.note: New licensees start on the first January 1 that falls in their first registration period.

licenseDateHint: Your three-year registration end date. Your yearly CPE runs January–December regardless.
issueDateHint: New licensees don't need CPE until the first January 1 after they're licensed.
